ArmTensors (frozen dataclass).adjacent_delta_hours: (n, slots) float64 raw hours between adjacent slots; first column 0 (the /24 conversion is the model's)
ArmTensors (frozen dataclass).head_mask/entry_mask/management_mask: (n, 6) bool, identical to the SplitPopulation masks and identical across arms
ArmTensors (frozen dataclass).offsets_hours: (n, slots) float64 ACTUAL signed UTC offsets from t; last column exactly 0
ArmTensors (frozen dataclass).slot_instants: (n, slots) int64 UTC epoch seconds; last column == row_id
ArmTensors (frozen dataclass).target_price: (n, 6) float64 exact ELAPSED p(t+h) where head_mask, NaN elsewhere (never filled)
ArmTensors (frozen dataclass).x: (n, slots, 19) float64 RAW exact values at the expected market slots, oldest -> t; slots = 25 (mg1) or 13 (mg2m)

CommonPopulation (frozen dataclass).digest: population digest = canonical sha256 of POPULATION.json body (container file digests excluded); deterministic across rebuilds
CommonPopulation (frozen dataclass).identities: dict: contrast_id, matched_population_rules_sha256, arms{mg1,mg2m: experiment_id, family, experiment_design_sha256, experiment_seal_sha256, data_design_sha256, data_identity_sha256, observations, spacing}, source{inputs{file: sha256}, input_sha256, source_clock, features, manifest/availability sha256}, calendar{calendar_id, version, status, sha256}, splits{bounds}, test{materialized: false}, code{commit, files_sha256}
CommonPopulation (frozen dataclass).naive_loss_scale: dict[int, float | None] FIT-only naive MAE per horizon on the common FIT mask (math.fsum of |p(t+h)-p(t)| / n); None = typed UNSUPPORTED_HEAD / ZERO_SCALE_HEAD, never filled
CommonPopulation (frozen dataclass).report: counts before/after intersection, typed exclusions, unsupported heads, scaler source-bar range (not part of the dataclass equality)
CommonPopulation (frozen dataclass).scaler: SharedScaler (the SAME statistics serve both arms)
CommonPopulation (frozen dataclass).splits: dict[str, SplitPopulation] for FIT, INNER, DEVELOPMENT

SharedScaler (frozen dataclass).feature_names: tuple[str, ...] the 19 MANIFEST_NO_STLFSI4 names in order
SharedScaler (frozen dataclass).fit_row_digest: array_sha256({'fit_source_bar_ts': sorted unique int64 UTC epochs of the union of MG1/MG2 slot bars of the common FIT origins})
SharedScaler (frozen dataclass).n_rows: int number of those unique source bars
SharedScaler (frozen dataclass).transform(x): (x - mean) / std on the last axis; any zero std raises ZERO_SCALE (never an epsilon)

SplitPopulation (frozen dataclass).counts: dict[int, int] per horizon = head_mask[:, j].sum()
SplitPopulation (frozen dataclass).digest: sha256 over name, the four arrays, row-id digest and counts
SplitPopulation (frozen dataclass).entry_mask: np.ndarray bool (n, 6) C1 ENTRY support under BOTH arms, subset of head_mask
SplitPopulation (frozen dataclass).head_mask: np.ndarray bool (n, 6) common valid (origin, horizon) pairs; horizons order (2,3,4,5,6,12); every row has >= 1 True
SplitPopulation (frozen dataclass).management_mask: np.ndarray bool (n, 6) C1 MANAGEMENT support under BOTH arms; identical to head_mask by construction (asserted on load)
SplitPopulation (frozen dataclass).name: 'FIT' | 'INNER' | 'DEVELOPMENT' (DEVELOPMENT = data-lane VALIDATION, full 2024)
SplitPopulation (frozen dataclass).origin_row_ids: np.ndarray int64 (n,) origin UTC epoch seconds, strictly increasing

api.arm_tensors(pop, arm_design, split) -> A: THE per-arm accessor both trainers, checkpoint monitors, annual scorers and weekly diagnostics must use. arm_design = the sealed EXPERIMENT.<arm>.json document; its design_sha256 must equal identities.arms[arm].experiment_design_sha256 (DESIGN_IDENTITY_MISMATCH otherwise; closed MG2 / hourly -> MATCHED_IDENTITY_REQUIRED; split 'TEST' -> SPLIT_UNKNOWN). Rows/heads are exactly SplitPopulation rows/masks (re-asserted). A population read from disk must come from load_common_population: the accessor re-reads ARM_*.npz and checks it against the digests RECOMPUTED by that verified load (CommonPopulation.verified_arm_digests), never the strings stored in POPULATION.json; an unverified source_dir population raises POPULATION_NOT_VERIFIED (review D3).
api.build_common_population(input_dir, exper: validates both sealed EXPERIMENTs (matched_arm) and DESIGNs, cross-checks data_design_sha256/data_identity_sha256/partner identity and the sealed calendar id/version against the input; refuses TEST bars (TEST_ROWS_PRESENT, before any array)
api.load_common_population(path, *, expected: recomputes every row/head/mask/arm/exclusion/scaler/identity digest; typed refusals ROW_DIGEST_MISMATCH, HEAD_MASK_DIGEST_MISMATCH, MASK_DIGEST_MISMATCH, ARM_ARRAYS_MISMATCH, EXCLUSIONS_MISMATCH, SCALER_ROWS_MISMATCH, CALENDAR_DIGEST_MISMATCH, SOURCE_DIGEST_MISMATCH, DESIGN_IDENTITY_MISMATCH, SPLIT_BOUNDS_MISMATCH, FILE_DIGEST_MISMATCH, POPULATION_DIGEST_MISMATCH, SPLIT_UNKNOWN, TEST_ROWS_PRESENT; with input_dir the retained INPUT/CALENDAR/CLOCK files must hash to the sealed source
api.replay_against_input(tensors, input_dir): independent replay of inputs/p(t)/exact p(t+h) by timestamp from INPUT.npz; REPLAY_MISMATCH on any difference
api.verify_source(pop_or_body, input_dir): file digests of the retained input vs the sealed source/calendar
api.write_common_population(pop, out_dir) ->: writes POPULATION.json, POPULATION_<SPLIT>.npz, EXCLUSIONS_<SPLIT>.npz, ARM_<arm>_<SPLIT>.npz, SCALER_ROWS.npz into a NEW/empty directory (POPULATION_EXISTS otherwise); returns the small committable seal (schema i6dmo.common_population.seal.v1)

cli.exit: 0 OK; 2 typed refusal printed as JSON {status: REFUSED, code}

designs.matched_identity_guard: design.matched_arm(doc) -> 'mg1'|'mg2m'; any other family (closed short_mg2 full-population MG2, long_mg12, short_hourly ELAPSED, short, long) raises DesignError MATCHED_IDENTITY_REQUIRED; a relabelled closed MG2 raises MATCHED_SCHEMA_REQUIRED
designs.model_lane_note: model.py has no 'short_mg1_matched'/'short_mg2_matched' model_config family yet; the 25-slot model, per-component parameter counts and the 2304-parameter disclosure (SC07) are MODEL's
designs.runtime_pin: design.MATCHED_RUNTIME = tensorflow 2.21.0 / keras 3.13.2 (execution roles); superseded seals in design.MATCHED_SUPERSEDED_SEALS are refused as MATCHED_IDENTITY_SUPERSEDED
designs.seal: python -m tools.i6dmo.design seal-matched-short --short-design docs/i6n/direct_multi_output_static/EXPERIMENT.short.json --out-dir docs/i6n/direct_multi_output_static/matched_short --json (idempotent; refuses different content)

exclusion_codes.precedence: C1 business/label reason (treatment-independent) first, then INPUT_INVALID_MG1_ONLY / INPUT_INVALID_MG2M_ONLY / INPUT_INVALID_BOTH

invariants: TEST never materialized; no TEST split, unit or file
no smoothing, interpolation, ASOF or next-observed-row targets; exact t+h only
missing open-session bars remain counted exclusions; slots are expected open-market hours of the versioned calendar; offsets are actual UTC
FIT-only shared scaler and naive loss scales; INNER/DEVELOPMENT cannot change them (SC04)
the closed full-population MG2 bundle/design is never accepted as the matched MG2 arm (SC06/SC10)
order: MUSASHI_TO_SATOSHI_SHORT_MATCHED_CONTROL_20261015 section A.1; NEXT_CONTRASTS_PLAN_20261015 section 2, SC01-SC04, SC10 (data part)

private_storage_layout.ARM_<arm>_<SPLIT>.npz: row_id, x, offsets_hours, adjacent_delta_hours, closure_crossed, slot_instants, origin_price, target_price, head_mask, entry_mask, management_mask, week_ids
private_storage_layout.EXCLUSIONS_<SPLIT>.npz: candidate_row_ids (every candidate origin of the split), head_reason (m,6) int8, input_reason_mg1 (m,) int8, input_reason_mg2m (m,) int8
